statements.proposition: The change still honours the API's legacy 'blocked' flag (backward compatible) and still respects the GEO_BLOCK=disabled environment variable.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: GEO_BLOCK=disabled is preserved, but the only read of the 'blocked' flag (data.valueOrNull<bool>('blocked') in TradingStatusRepository.isTradingEnabled) is removed and no added line anywhere in the 48-file diff reads 'blocked'. The new fetchStatus blocks trading whenever disallowed_features is absent from the response, so a legacy-shaped response with blocked:false would now block trading. Only the diff was inspected, not the full head tree or the live API; the first half of the sentence (blocked flag) is the part judged false.
evidence: gh api pulls/3150/files (48 files): trading_status_repository.dart patch removes line 'return !(data.valueOrNull<bool>("blocked") ?? true);'
regex search of all 48 patches for 'blocked' or "blocked" string literals and GEO_BLOCK: only GEO_BLOCK additions (_isGeoBlockDisabled, fetchStatus), no added 'blocked' read
fetchStatus: if disallowed_features missing, logs 'Blocking trading' and returns disallowedFeatures {trading}
isTradingEnabled kept as 'Backward-compatible helper' for call sites only, not for the API flag
